no-history-read: no history was read: this is not a git repository
history-before: history was not read before the clone's first commit
feature-code-on-a-file: a feature file already has the feature code
not-a-feature-code: this is not a feature code, two to five uppercase letters or digits
unknown-feature-code: no feature file has the feature code asked for, named first; the feature files have the ones after it
unreadable-in-tree: allocate could not read this, and gives no code
unreadable-history: allocate could not read the repository's history, and gives no code
damaged-repository: allocate could not read the repository, and gives no code
feature-file-does-not-parse: allocate could not read this feature file, which does not parse, and gives no code
